answer: One concrete sybil defense is staked vouching. A new agent begins as a faint ember, acting only after an established member posts a refundable bond. If exposed as a sybil, the voucher is slashed, so sponsors screen identities rather than rubber-stamp them. Unproven agents stay on a low-trust island without votes or shared funds, until honest history earns them the haven of full-weight accounts. Each fake identity needs its own bond or a funded backer risking capital, so mass wallets are no longer free and each sybil raises the attacker's cost.
